profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company, ticker META, CIK 0001326801, founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California. Its AI developer site describes building with Meta's AI models and tools, with access to Muse Spark through Muse Code and the Meta Model API. The company describes Muse Spark as tuned for long-horizon coding workflows, with fewer unnecessary turns and cleaner output, and says it performs competitively with frontier models across several coding evals. It advertises a quick start in which a first working request takes under five minutes by pointing an existing OpenAI SDK compatible client at the Meta Model API, and search grounding that gives a model live access to the web by adding a single tool to a request.

The product tracked for Meta is Llama (Meta), described as an open-weight model family that is often self-hosted, in the chat and general LLM category.

Meta's most recent 10-K, for the period ending 2025-12-31, reported revenue of $200,966,000,000. Litigation involving the company is concentrated in California, with 281 cases there, and named matters include State of New Mexico ex rel. Torrez v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the First Judicial District Court, Santa Fe County, New Mexico; Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the District Court, W.D. Texas; Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the District Court, N.D. California; and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the U.S. District Court, N.D. California. MCP servers associated with the company include Meta Ads automation tools such as ai.adweave/meta-ads-mcp, which offers 47 tools for campaigns, creatives, audiences, and insights, co.pipeboard/meta-ads-mcp, and com.adbloop/meta-ads, alongside others whose names contain Meta, among them app.metadock/metadock, ai.metabind/docs, ai.metabind/banking-assistant, ai.livingmeta/ai-in-research, ai.fastmetal/fastmetal, and ai.primeta/primeta.
